rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for stating that something is definitely true or will definitely happen.

example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this when confidently asserting that a fact is beyond doubt, especially before a verb or negation.

example.english: They definitely won’t lie to you.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 ding6 m4 wui5 aak1 nei5

rows.note: Choose this for emphatic ‘definitely’ or ‘absolutely,’ stronger than the neutral choice.

example.english: I definitely won’t accept this explanation.
example.traditional: 我絕對唔接受呢個解釋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyut6 deoi3 m4 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 gaai2 sik1

rows.note: Use this conversationally when ‘definitely’ means ‘of course’ in response to an obvious or expected point.

example.english: Of course I’ll definitely help you!
example.jyutping: gang2 hai6 jiu3 bong1 nei5 laa1
